senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced. wds.) childhood, youth; waywardness.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 52b:15">Ab. Zar. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>שנית לנו ביַלְדּוּתְךָ וכ׳</he> in thy earlier days thou didst teach us &c.; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 44a">B. Mets. 44ᵃ</cite> (not <he>בילדותיך</he>).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 131a:5">B. Bath. 131ᵃ</cite> <he>י׳ היתה בי וכ׳</he> I was wayward and set my face against &c.; a. e.
